game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Shadow Pit Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Shadow Pit.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: In Shadow Pit, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before glow-eyed lurkers overload Shadow Pit. Each round, a new lantern oil challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of lantern oil by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

code_snippet:
while n < 5:
    print(n)  # n never changes
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
